title: Sida Loo Soo Dejiyo Fiidiyowyada Facebook oo Gallery-ga Loo Geeyo
description: Ka soo deji fiidiyowyada Facebook Gallery-ga Android iyo iPhone adigoon app isticmaalin. Koobiyee link-ga, ku dheji I Need Save, dooro tayada, kaydi.
photoCaption: Fiidiyow ka yimid qoraal Facebook oo dadweyne ah.
photo2Caption: Kaliya fiidiyowyada dadweynaha ayaa la soo dejin karaa.
body:
Facebook waxaa ka buuxa fiidiyowyo xiiso leh, laga bilaabo cuntooyin karis, talooyin beerashada, qaybo ciyaaraha ka mid ah, ilaa fiidiyowyo qosol leh oo ka yimid kooxaha aad jeceshahay. Nasiib darro, ma jiro badhan gudaha ku dhisan oo si toos ah ugu kaydiya Gallery-ga. Maqaalkan waxaad ku baran doontaa sida loo soo dejiyo fiidiyowyada Facebook oo loogu kaydiyo Gallery-ga taleefanka adigoo isticmaalaya I Need Save, qalab bilaash ah oo shabakadda ku shaqeeya, kaas oo aad isticmaali karto adigoon app rakibin iyo adigoon gelin.

Maxaad U Baahan Tahay?

Diyaargarowgu aad buu u yar yahay:

  • Taleefan ama kombiyuutar leh browser iyo internet.
  • Link-ga fiidiyow Facebook ah oo ka yimid qoraal dadweyne ah.
  • Meel bannaan oo yar oo ku jirta kaydka qalabkaaga.

Intaas ayay ku egtahay. Uma baahnid inaad akoon ka furato I Need Save, umana baahnid inaad geliso xogta gelitaanka Facebook-gaaga.

Sida Loo Soo Dejiyo Fiidiyowyada Facebook ee Taleefanka

Raac tallaabooyinkan, ha ahaato Android ama iPhone:

  1. Fur app-ka Facebook oo hel fiidiyowga aad rabto inaad kaydiso.
  2. Taabo badhanka La wadaag (Share) ee ka hooseeya fiidiyowga.
  3. Dooro Koobiyee link-ga (Copy link).
  4. Fur browser-ka, kadibna booqo ineedsave.com.
  5. Ku dheji link-ga sanduuqa halkaas yaal, ama taabo badhanka Dheji.
  6. Riix Soo deji oo sug inta liiska doorashooyinku soo baxayo.
  7. Dooro tayada fiidiyow ee aad rabto. Soo dejintu way bilaabanaysaa.

Fiidiyowyada qaarkood, badhanku marka hore wuxuu muujinayaa Waa la diyaarinayaa…. Tani waxay dhacdaa marka fiidiyowga marka hore loo baahdo in la habeeyo, tusaale ahaan marka fiidiyowga iyo codka la isku darayo ama stream loo beddelayo MP4. Kaliya sug, maxaa yeelay soo dejintu si toos ah ayay u bilaabanaysaa marka faylku diyaar noqdo.

Sida Loo Soo Dejiyo Fiidiyowyada Facebook ee Kombiyuutarka

Laptop ama PC, tallaabooyinku waa isku mid. Ka fur Facebook browser-ka, guji fiidiyowga aad rabto, kadibna ka koobiyee link-giisa menu-ga La wadaag ama address bar-ka. Ka fur bogga soo dejinta tab cusub, dheji link-ga, guji Soo deji, oo dooro doorashada jirta. Faylka waxaa lagu kaydin doonaa galka Downloads (Soo dejisyada).

Faa'iidooyinka Soo Dejinta I Need Save

  • Bilaash oo app looma baahna. Kaliya ka fur bogga browser-ka taleefanka ama kombiyuutarka.
  • Gelitaan looma baahna. Uma baahnid inaad meelna geliso xogta akoonkaaga Facebook.
  • Waxay u shaqaysaa barxado kale. Facebook ka sokow, waxaad sidoo kale kaydin kartaa fiidiyowyo ka yimid TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter), iyo barxado kale oo la taageero.
  • Way fududahay in la isticmaalo. Bogga wuxuu ku jiraa 93 luqadood, oo ay ku jirto Soomaaliga.

Doorashada Tayada Fiidiyow ee Ku Habboon

Marka link-ga la habeeyo kadib, I Need Save waxay ku tusaysaa dhowr doorasho. Waxa soo baxaa way kala duwanaan karaan fiidiyow kasta:

  • Fiidiyow tayooyin kala duwan leh, tusaale ahaan 360p, 720p, ama 1080p, iyadoo ku xiran fiidiyowga asalka ah.
  • Cod tayadiisa asalka ah ama MP3 192 kbps ah oo laga beddelay fiidiyowga.
  • Sawir / Sawir yar oo fiidiyowgaas ah.

Guud ahaan, 1080p waxay bixisaa sawirka ugu cad, 720p waxay isku dheellitirtaa tayada iyo cabbirka faylka, halka 360p ay ugu badbaadiso data-da iyo kaydka. Sharaxaad dhammaystiran waxay ku jirtaa maqaalka farqiga u dhexeeya tayada fiidiyowga 360p, 720p iyo 1080p.

Si Fiidiyowgu Ugu Soo Baxo Gallery-ga Taleefanka

Kani waa qaybta inta badan dadka jahwareeriya. Marka soo dejintu dhammaato kadib, fiidiyowgu had iyo jeer kuma soo baxo Gallery-ga isla markiiba. Waa kan sharaxaaddu.

Android

Fiidiyowga waxaa lagu kaydiyaa galka Downloads (Soo dejisyada). App-ka Gallery inta badan wuu muujiyaa, laakiin mararka qaarkood waqti yar ayuu qaataa. Haddii uusan weli soo bixin, wax yar sug ama ka fur galka Downloads app-ka maamulka faylasha.

iPhone iyo iPad

Haddii aad ku soo dejisay Safari, fiidiyowgu wuxuu galaa app-ka Files (Faylasha), galka Downloads (Soo dejisyada). Si aad ugu wareejiso app-ka Photos (Sawirrada):

  1. Fur app-ka Files oo gal galka Downloads.
  2. Taabo fiidiyowga aad hadda soo dejisay.
  3. Taabo badhanka Share (La wadaag).
  4. Dooro Save Video (Kaydi Fiidiyowga).

Hadda fiidiyowgu wuxuu ku jiraa Gallery-gaaga, waxaadna u daawan kartaa sida fiidiyowyada kale. Faylasha MP4 ee ka yimaada I Need Save waxay leeyihiin muddo sax ah, sidaas darteed si fiican ayay uga shaqeeyaan app-yada Gallery.

Talo: Haddii aad inta badan soo dejiso fiidiyowyo, si joogto ah u nadiifi galka Downloads si uusan kaydka taleefankaagu dhakhso u buuxsamin.

Fiidiyowga Facebook Ma Soo Degayo?

Noocyada nuxurka qaarkood lama soo dejin karo:

  • Fiidiyowyo ka yimid akoonno ama kooxo gaar ah.
  • Nuxur la arki karo kaliya marka la galo.
  • Fiidiyowyo gobollo gaar ah loo xaddiday.

Sidoo kale hubi in link-ga aad dhejisay uu yahay link fiidiyow, ee uusan ahayn link bog ama profile. Haddii aad shaki ka qabto, mar kale ka koobiyee badhanka La wadaag ee fiidiyowga.

Ammaan iyo Mas'uuliyad

Fiidiyowga si toos ah ayaa looga soo gudbiyaa Facebook ilaa qalabkaaga, laguma kaydiyo server-ka I Need Save. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa aad soo dejisay u isticmaal kaliya isticmaal shakhsi ah. Ixtiraam xuquuqda daabacaadda (copyright) ee sameeyaha fiidiyowga: weydiiso ogolaansho ka hor intaadan dib u daabicin, oo ku xus magaca milkiilihiisa asalka ah.

Su'aalaha Inta Badan La Is Weydiiyo

Ma soo dejin karaa fiidiyowyada Facebook anigoon app isticmaalin?

Haa. I Need Save si toos ah ayay browser-ka uga shaqaysaa, sidaas darteed uma baahnid inaad wax app ah rakibto.

Maxaa fiidiyowgu isla markiiba ugu soo bixi waayaa Gallery-ga?

Android, Gallery-ga mararka qaarkood waqti yar ayuu u baahan yahay si uu u muujiyo faylasha cusub. iPhone, fiidiyowgu marka hore wuxuu galaa app-ka Files, kadibna waa inaad doorataa Save Video si uu u galo Photos.

Ma qaadan karaa codka oo keliya?

Haa. Dooro doorashada Cod, ha ahaato tayada asalka ah ama MP3 192 kbps.
